faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Prayagraj District Court Special Judicial Magistrate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Prayagraj District Court Special Judicial Magistrate post is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Special Judicial Magistrate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Special Judicial Magistrate post in the Prayagraj District Court.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Special Judicial Magistrate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold or have held any post under the Government and possess a degree of law or be well-experienced in legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Special Judicial Magistrate post is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Special Judicial Magistrate post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny by the District Judge and forwarding to the High Court.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Prayagraj District Court located?
faq.answer: The Prayagraj District Court is located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, candidates must apply through offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.
